description: Reviewed Kassandora Act 1 desert and floating ruins. Source IDs are provenance only; runtime matches displayed pixels, palette slots, collision and priority. Sand and rock islands span the walking path, bone spines and jaws join across the path and colliding ruin ledges retain complete native silhouettes, noncolliding ribs and rock pillars use slender relief, masonry walls sit behind the path, and cacti use crossed native profiles. Native black window interiors remain opaque.

materials.review: The alternate native sand phase retains exactly the reviewed dune opacity, collision and priority; only nonzero palette indices animate.
